newsitem.title: THAILAND: Somprasong asked to refile balance sheet.
newsitem.headline: Somprasong asked to refile balance sheet.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said on Thursday it had instructed Songprasong Land Plc to improve and refile its balance sheets by including adequate information disclosure.
A statement from the SET said the bourse would order special book audits on Somprasong if the residential housing developer failed to improve balance sheets to standards stipulated by Thai laws.

Somprasong shares have been suspended from trading since October 29 after some of its executives filed complaints with the white collar crime police that the company's balance sheets contained false information.
